en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Shaking the Head.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks walked through inhabited areas swaying their heads and letting their heads hang down... [etc. ...
"The training is to be observed: 'I shall not walk through an inhabited area swaying my head.
One must not walk through an inhabited area swaying one's head.
One should walk with the head held up.
Whoever, out of disrespect, walks through an inhabited area shaking their head or letting it hang down commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
"Unintentionally... [as before] ...for one who is a first-time offender.
The ninth training rule is concluded.
